# usage

Cost accounting, usage summaries, budgets, output rates and live token counts.

- **Runs in:** the harness process
- **Source:** [lisp/modules/harness-usage.el](../../lisp/modules/harness-usage.el)
- **Loaded:** by default
- **Requires:** [store](store.md), [session](session.md), [provider](provider.md)
- **Required by:** [cost-compare](cost-compare.md)
- **Brings along:** [ui-usage](ui-usage.md) (its UI)

## About

Every model call ends in a `session/usage` event.  This module prices
it when the provider did not, writes one row per call to the `usage`
table of usage.db (or to usage/records.jsonl when Emacs lacks
SQLite), and answers questions about spending: summaries grouped by
project, model, day, hour, session or billing; totals; and
continuous time series for charts.  A row is recorded under its
session's project, which for a task or a sub-agent working in a git
worktree is that worktree, so summaries by project also say which
main checkout each project belongs to, for the dashboard to fold the
worktrees under it.

A row's cost is what was billed.  Its list cost is what the call
costs at API prices, and its billing says who paid: `api` (per
token), `subscription` (a plan such as Claude Max paid, so the cost is
0) or `extra-usage` (a plan's extra usage, billed at API prices).
Budgets count the cost, so usage a subscription covers spends none.

Budgets live in budgets.json.  A budget has a scope (one session,
one project, or a calendar period across everything), an amount and
a hardness.  Period budgets know how much of the period is left and
split the remainder across the remaining days, business days or all.
A budget over everything (a period budget for no one project)
backfills from what providers report they billed in its period
beyond what the harness recorded: a plan's extra usage (Claude
Code's usage credits, Copilot's additional requests) for a month,
and, with an Admin API key, Anthropic's cost report for a day, week
or month (see "Spending providers report" below).
A budget may carry a baseline: what was already spent that the
harness never recorded and no provider reports (in other tools, or
before it kept usage), set by hand so a budget made mid-period does
not start at $0.  A period budget's baseline counts only in the
period it was set for; one without a period always counts it.
A session's own `:budget` plist is an implicit hard-or-soft budget
with scope session, and the Budget setting (`harness-budget`) one
implicit budget, "settings", for all sessions together: it counts
everything recorded.  Hard budgets stop a turn: the
`agent/before-turn` gate refuses to start one, and the `agent/step`
gate refuses the next step of a running one, so a long turn cannot
spend far past its cap (the step in flight finishes, then the turn
ends `blocked` with the reason as a hint).  Every budget warns once at
80% and soft ones once more at 100%, as an event and as a session
hint.

Storage is one code path: rows are loaded from whichever backend is
in use into plists and aggregated in Lisp.  SQLite only narrows the
rows it returns; the Lisp filter and aggregation are the reference.

Output rates say how fast each session's model writes: the output
tokens of its latest model calls, as the usage records count them,
over the seconds the agent's activity spent streaming them (see
"Output rate" below).  They are measured here, in the harness, and
kept in memory; `usage/rate-updated` announces each new one.  The
output and seconds of every measured call are also added up in the
session's own usage totals (`:stream-output` and `:stream-seconds`,
see `session/usage-note`), which say how fast it wrote over its whole
life and are kept with it.

Live usage lets a running session's token figures, its context and
its output, grow while its model streams: what streamed since the
provider last reported usage is estimated, and each report replaces
the estimate with real numbers (see "Live usage" below).  That too is
counted here, in memory; `usage/live-updated` announces the figures
a few times a second at most.

## Provides

### Methods

- `usage/budget-block` (session-id) — Return why a hard budget forbids another request in SESSION-ID, or nil.
- `usage/budget-status` (id &rest opts) — Return the status of budget ID (or of a BUDGET plist passed as ID).
- `usage/budgets` — Return every explicit budget plist.
- `usage/fetch-api-cost` (&rest opts) — Fetch what Anthropic billed the organisation this period, without blocking.
- `usage/live` (session-id) — Return the token figures of SESSION-ID while its turn runs, or nil.
- `usage/live-all` — Return the live token figures of every running session.
- `usage/plan-budget` (amount period days &optional now) — Split AMOUNT over the calendar PERIOD (day|week|month) containing NOW.
- `usage/price` (model-id usage &optional at) — Return the USD cost of USAGE on MODEL-ID.
- `usage/project-budgets` (project &rest opts) — Return the status of every budget applying to PROJECT, a root.
- `usage/rate` (session-id) — Return how fast SESSION-ID's model writes, or nil if it was never measured.
- `usage/rates` — Return the output rate of every measured session, newest first.
- `usage/record` (row) — Persist usage ROW and return it with `:id` set.
- `usage/remove-budget` (id) — Remove the budget ID.  Return non-nil when one was removed.
- `usage/series` (&rest opts) — Return a continuous time series of usage per OPTS `:bucket` (day|hour).
- `usage/session-budgets` (session-id &rest opts) — Return the status of every budget applying to SESSION-ID.
- `usage/set-budget` (budget) — Add BUDGET, or replace the budget with the same `:id`.  Return it.
- `usage/summary` (&rest opts) — Return usage aggregated by OPTS `:group-by`.
- `usage/totals` (&rest opts) — Return one aggregate of every row the filters in OPTS select.

### Events

- `usage/budget-warning` — (SESSION-ID BUDGET STATUS) when a budget crosses 80% or 100%.
- `usage/budgets-changed` — (BUDGETS) after a budget is added, replaced or removed.
- `usage/live-updated` — (SESSION-ID LIVE) while the session's turn runs, at most every `harness-usage-live-interval` seconds: its token figures as `usage/live` returns them, which grow as its model streams; LIVE is nil once the turn ended.
- `usage/rate-updated` — (SESSION-ID RATE) after a model call of the session was measured; RATE as `usage/rate` returns it.
- `usage/recorded` — (ROW) after a usage row is stored.
- `usage/reported-changed` — (REPORT) when a provider reports a new amount billed, which budgets over everything count.

### Options

- `harness-anthropic-admin-api-key` — Anthropic Admin API key, to fetch this month's API cost for a budget.
- `harness-usage-cost-report-interval` — Seconds before Anthropic's cost report is fetched again for budgets.
- `harness-usage-live-interval` — Least seconds between two announcements of a session's live token figures.
- `harness-usage-rate-window` — Seconds of streaming that a session's output rate averages over.
- `harness-usage-warn-fraction` — Fraction of a budget at which the first warning is issued.
